name: TantrumCon
blurb: An annual board-game convention in Charlotte, North Carolina, run by the Tantrum House board-game media company.
notes: The official site currently shows only 'TANTRUMCON 2027 INFO COMING SOON' with no dates, venue or links at all (a bare one-page placeholder), so no 2027 edition is recorded. A web search (news coverage) confirms TantrumCon has run annually in Charlotte every January/February, most recently Feb 5-8, 2026 at the Le Méridien Charlotte, which already ended well before the 2026-10-05 research window, so it is recorded as 'last'. Organizer Tantrum House confirmed via local news coverage ('TantrumCon, Tantrum House's annual board game convention, returns to the Queen City'). Guests/exhibitors were not researched since there is no upcoming edition to attach them to.
